title: Least prime above the binary size bound
statement: For each natural number $n$, define $p(n)$ to be the least prime strictly greater than $2^{\lceil\log_2(2n)\rceil}+1$, where $\lceil\log_2(2n)\rceil$ is the least natural number $k$ such that $2n \le 2^k$.
